description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of tasks assigned to each language family, with the language families listed along the vertical axis in descending order of task count and the number of tasks shown along the horizontal axis, which is labeled “# tasks” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10. The bars are colored differently for each language family and their approximate values are: IE-Slavic (light blue, 79 tasks), IE-Romance (dark blue, 47 tasks), IE-Germanic (light green, 44 tasks), Uralic (dark green, 20 tasks), IE-Baltic (pink, 17 tasks), IE-other (red, 15 tasks), IE-Indic (orange, 10 tasks), Semitic (brown, 9 tasks), Turkic (light purple, 5 tasks), and Basque (dark purple, 3 tasks). The chart does not include a legend, but the color coding distinguishes each language family visually. The bars are sorted in descending order from top to bottom based on their length, with IE-Slavic having the longest bar and Basque the shortest. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
